text: ハーバーシティは前半45分のエリアス・オカフォールと47分のマレク・バロスの連続ゴールでリードを奪いましたが、シーブルックタウンが53分以降に効果的なカウンターとサイド攻撃を活かし、4ゴールを決め大逆転勝利を収めました[#905][#975][#1104][#1448][#1882][#1906]。シーブルックタウンのキアン・ロマノは終了間際の90+2分、90+3分に2連続得点し試合を決定付けました[#1882][#1906]。この試合で最も輝いたのはマレク・バロスで、彼は1ゴールと2アシスト、さらに5つのチャンスを演出しパフォーマンス評価10.0を獲得しました[#975]。シーブルックタウンはシュート数22本、得点期待値xGは3.53と高い攻撃力を示し、最後まで攻め続けたことが勝因です。一方、ハーバーシティは試合序盤は優勢でしたが後半は失速し、押される展開に苦しみました.

trace.output: Brief: full-match recap for fan audience in ja

- Seabrook Town won with a final score of 4-2 against Harbour City [#905, #975, #1104, #1448, #1882, #1906].
- Marek Barros was the player of the match with 1 goal, 2 assists, 5 key passes, and a rating of 10.0 [#975].
- Seabrook Town created higher expected goals (xG) with 3.53 compared to Harbour City's 1.26 [#fact packet].
- Harbour City scored early with goals at 45' and 47', but Seabrook Town came back scoring 4 goals after 53' [#905, #975, #1104, #1448, #1882, #1906].
- Kian Romano scored twice for Seabrook Town in stoppage time (90+2' and 90+3') securing the win [#1882, #1906].

- Seabrook Town’s goals late in the match (90+2', 90+3') came from quick regains and counter-attacks, as shown by ball recoveries followed by rapid forward passing and through balls, exploiting Harbour City's pressing and higher line after their late tactical change to press higher and play more direct [1882,1884,1906]. This reflects Seabrook’s 3-4-3 formation and wide crossing style, with quick wide play and penetrative through balls.
- Harbour City scored first via a patient, extended build-up involving 17 passes over almost a minute before a through ball assist to Elias Okafor, demonstrating their 4-2-3-1 formation and patient short passing style [905]. Their second goal came immediately after from a corner cross by Marek Barros—who also had a high involvement in key passes and interceptions—showing set-piece effectiveness layered on top of their controlled buildup [975].
- Seabrook Town’s first goal (53') and Callum Varga’s goal (69') came quickly off ball recoveries and relatively short passing sequences involving through balls—indicating effective pressing with a moderately high line (press increased at 65'), forcing turnovers and launching direct attacking plays in line with their coach’s approach of wide, crossing play and increasing directness and pressing intensity [1104,1361,1448].
- Harbour City’s pressing and defensive efforts slightly weakened in the second half (ppda improved from 8.3 to 7.6 but less possession and fewer box touches), while Seabrook Town’s higher pressing (ppda dropped from 6.6 to 4.9) and field tilt (from 52.3% to 63.8%) allowed them more attacking opportunities, particularly via overlaps and wide play consistent with their 3-4-3 formation [team_stats,second_half].
